settings.aboutTitle: A harmonious blend of comfort and elegance
settings.aboutText: Our charming hotel in the heart of the Balkan Mountains offers a serene atmosphere, well-appointed rooms and high-end amenities, wrapped in the regional design charm of Tryavna — all backed by attentive, always-reachable service.

rooms.name: Apartment with Balcony
rooms.description: A spacious apartment with a private balcony framing the Balkan Mountains, a separate lounge area and room for the whole family to spread out.

rooms.name: Double Room with Balcony
rooms.description: A calm, well-appointed double room with balcony access, ideal for couples visiting Tryavna for a quiet mountain escape.

rooms.name: Town Suite
rooms.description: Our largest suite, combining regional design charm with high-end comfort — steps away from Tryavna's old town.

rooms.name: Triple Room with Balcony
rooms.description: A comfortable triple room with balcony, well suited for small families or friends travelling together.

events.title: Rodzheta Contest — The Living Heritage
events.description:
A two-day heritage celebration hosted at Park Hotel Panorama: a folk costume and tradition contest with individual and group categories, prizes for the most authentic representation, plus a craft market with local products and homemade goods.
Contest entries: 089 057 2865
Hotel bookings: 089 782 0065.

amenities.title: Pool & Spa
amenities.text: Unwind in our spa centre with sauna, steam bath and a heated pool.

amenities.title: Cultural Sites
amenities.text: Museums, workshops and cultural landmarks are all within easy reach.

amenities.title: Bike Trails
amenities.text: Explore scenic bike trails starting right from the hotel's doorstep.

amenities.title: Local Cuisine
amenities.text: Taste authentic Bulgarian flavours and traditional regional specialties.

amenities.title: Wineries
amenities.text: Guided wine tastings and vineyard visits in the surrounding valleys.

amenities.title: Hiking Trails
amenities.text: Trails for every level, from gentle village walks to mountain peaks.
